hypothesis: The expansion history measured by DESI DR2 BAO and Pantheon+ supernovae can be produced by the parent action: a thawing psi with xi_c restricted to what Cassini, lunar laser ranging and T001 allow today fits the data about as well as a free linear w(a) (CPL).

observable.quantity: dchi2_CPL = chi2_min(UET family) - chi2_min(CPL) for BAO + SN distances
observable.domain: 0.01 < z < 2.5; flat FRW; pressureless matter; radiation neglected

prediction_method.description: Distances from H(z) of each model: LCDM (Omega_m), CPL (Omega_m, w0, wa; Nelder-Mead from four starts) and the UET family (uet_frw_background.py; grid xi_c in {0, -0.01, -0.003, 0.003, 0.01, 0.02, 0.03, 0.05}, psi_i in {0.1..1.2}, m/H0 in {0.5, 1, 2, 3, 4}; only points passing Cassini, LLR and T001 today). Omega_m profiled on 0.20..0.42 in steps of 0.01 for LCDM and UET. BAO amplitude c/(H0 r_d) and the SN offset profiled analytically. Pantheon+ rows with zHD > 0.01 and the matching STAT+SYS covariance block.

fixed_parameters: flat FRW; radiation neglected at z < 2.5 (AI choice)
UET scan grid and Omega_m grid as in prediction_method (AI choice)
Pantheon+ cut zHD > 0.01 (AI choice, the usual cosmology cut)
bounds applied today: Cassini |gamma - 1| < 2.3e-5, LLR |dG/dt / G| < 2.2e-3 H0, xi_c outside [2.0, 2.4] (T001)
no CMB information (option B of the proposal not taken)
fail_criterion: FAIL if dchi2_CPL > 9. INCONCLUSIVE if 4 < dchi2_CPL <= 9.
note: Proposal: topics/0.3_Cosmology_Hubble_Tension/Doc/PROPOSAL_T033_W_OF_A_2026-11-25.md. Disclosure: not blind. The drafter knows the published DESI DR2 result that BAO with CMB and SN prefers w0 > -1, wa < 0 in CPL at about 2.8 to 4.2 sigma depending on the SN set, with a crossing of w = -1 near z = 0.4 to 0.5, and that the preference is weaker without the CMB. C1 found the UET family has w0 >= -1 and phantom phases only at z > 1.5. The drafter expects the outcome to be PASS or INCONCLUSIVE without the CMB. Reported, not deciding: dchi2_LCDM = chi2_min(LCDM) - chi2_min(UET) and the UET best-fit (w0, wa).
